items.place: Pasighat, East Siang, and Geku, Upper Siang, Arunachal Pradesh
items.headline: Siang dam opponents refuse talks until detainees freed
items.text: A farmers' forum rejected the chief minister's offer of talks on 5–7 November until detainees are freed and armed forces withdrawn; a foot march heads to Itanagar. No government reply was reported.

photo.alt: A wide river with sandbanks and a long bridge, seen between forested hills, under a cloudy sky.
photo.caption: The Siang river near Pasighat, where the farmers' forum is based, in 2023.

items.headline: Police remove Ankita Bhandari's parents from Raj Ghat
items.text: Police detained the parents of Ankita Bhandari, killed in 2022, at Raj Ghat late Wednesday; her father says they were dragged. Police cite a prohibitory order against a planned indefinite sit-in.

photo.alt: A black marble platform decorated with orange marigold rings and an eternal flame lamp, in a walled garden with trees.
photo.caption: The Raj Ghat memorial to Mahatma Gandhi in New Delhi, in 2022.

items.headline: Rights groups challenge police bid to remove accounts
items.text: Two digital rights groups asked the Delhi High Court to quash reports purportedly from Delhi Police asking X to remove their accounts; police have neither confirmed nor withdrawn them, the groups say.

items.place: Allahabad High Court · Farrukhabad, Uttar Pradesh
items.headline: Court orders FIR against officer over arrest papers
items.text: The Allahabad High Court found an investigating officer later added arrest grounds to Mohd Yaseen's papers, freed him and ordered an FIR against the officer. The state said the grounds were supplied and signed.

photo.alt: A large cream stone court building with a pediment, red-tiled roofs and an Indian flag, behind lawns and potted plants.
photo.caption: The Allahabad High Court building in Prayagraj, in 2009.

items.headline: 24-hour clock starts at detention, court rules
items.text: The Supreme Court ruled the 24-hour limit to bring someone before a magistrate runs from detention, not formal arrest, and freed four Tripura drug-case accused held about 21 hours first. No state reply was reported.

photo.alt: A domed red and cream building with an Indian flag, behind trees and a black statue on a pedestal.
photo.caption: The Supreme Court of India in New Delhi, in 2019.

items.headline: Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam seek Supreme Court bail
items.text: Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam appealed against the Delhi High Court's 30 September bail denial; Imam says none of 47 protected witnesses has been examined. Police allege a larger conspiracy behind the 2020 violence.

photo.alt: A domed red and cream building with an Indian flag, behind trees and a black statue on a pedestal.
photo.caption: The Supreme Court of India in New Delhi, in 2019.

items.headline: Security summons two striking teachers in Khartoum
items.text: Security services summoned two teachers in Ombada over alleged incitement of a strike now in its third week, the Sudanese Teachers Committee said; no statement from the authorities was reported.

photo.alt: A donkey cart beside a dusty street with a painted wall and a white building behind.
photo.caption: A street in Khartoum, Sudan's capital, in 2013.

items.headline: Australia sanctions Sudan's army and RSF leaders
items.text: Australia imposed sanctions and travel bans on army chief al-Burhan, RSF leader Dagalo and two others, citing attacks on civilians, torture and killings; no response from those named was reported.

items.place: Deir el-Balah, Bureij and Khan Younis, Gaza
items.headline: Israeli fire kills four in Gaza, including child
items.text: Israeli drone strikes and fire killed at least four Palestinians, including a child in Bureij camp, medical sources said on Thursday; no Israeli military comment was reported.

photo.alt: A two-storey blue and white school building with laundry and blankets hanging from every balcony, under a UN flag.
photo.caption: An UNRWA school in Deir el-Balah used as a shelter for displaced families, January 2025.
photo.credit: Ashraf Amra / UNRWA, via Wikimedia Commons

items.place: Biddu, northwest of Jerusalem, occupied West Bank
items.headline: Five homes demolished in Biddu
items.text: Israeli forces demolished five homes in Biddu, displacing more than 100 Palestinians, Al Jazeera reported on Thursday; residents said they had tried to stop it in court. No Israeli reason was reported.

photo.alt: Terraced hillsides with olive trees under a cloudy sky, with a village of white buildings along the ridge.
photo.caption: Biddu and its terraced hills, in 2012.

items.place: Paris, Lyon and cities across France
items.headline: Hundreds of thousands march in France; 448 detained
items.text: Between 575,000 (Interior Ministry) and 1.6 million (CGT) marched for higher wages; police used tear gas in Lyon and Paris and detained 448. The government defended police and said any abuses would be investigated.

photo.alt: A bronze statue of a woman holding an olive branch on a tall stone monument, against a blue sky.
photo.caption: The Monument to the Republic at Place de la République, Paris, a usual rally point, in 2026.

items.headline: California commutes all 548 death sentences
items.text: Governor Newsom commuted all 548 California death sentences to life without parole, saying state killing is "incompatible with California's values"; about two-thirds need state Supreme Court review first.

photo.alt: A long cream-coloured prison complex on the shore of a bay, with green hills and houses behind.
photo.caption: San Quentin State Prison, Marin County, California, in 2017.

focus.title: The fight over the Siang dam
focus.dek: A farmers' forum refuses the chief minister's talks offer until detainees are freed; police say 69 were arrested after arson on 23 October.
focus.alt: A wide, calm river between forested hills, with tall grass in the foreground.
